GenAiFunction.description: Use this when the customer asks about the health of their HVAC/comfort system, a system checkup, a maintenance tune-up, or their air filter. Shows an overall health score, per-system status (furnace, AC, thermostat, ductwork, filter), a filter-life bar, the next maintenance due date, a recommendation, and lets them book a maintenance visit.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: ASA HVAC · Comfort System Health Report
